front: Mislead a foe in melee with a Deception check so your real attack catches them off-guard.
back:
Deception vs. target's Perception DC.
Crit Success: target is off-guard against your melee attacks until end of your next turn.
Success: target is off-guard against your next melee attack before end of your current turn.
Crit Failure: you are off-guard against the target's melee attacks until end of your next turn.
